parameters.name: RefreshConfigType
parameters.description:
The configuration type. Valid values:
- **0**: host refresh task
- **1**: cloud service refresh task
- **2**: AccessKey scheduled verification task.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region of the Security Center instance.

parameters.name: TargetId
parameters.description: The ID of the AccessKey record specified when querying an AccessKey scheduled verification task.
